KubeLabelSelector.description: Kubernetes Label Selector for matching labels in Kubernetes Selector Groups.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

matchLabels.description:
matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels
map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the
operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

LabelSelectorExpression.description:
A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that
relates the key and values.

key.description:
key is a string of 63 characters or less, and must consist of alphanumeric characters,
'-', '_' or '.'.

values.description:
values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn,
the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist,
the values array must be empty.

LabelSelectorOperator.description: operator represents a Kubernetes label selector requirement's relationship to a set of values.

values.description: The label value must be in the supplied set of values.
values.name: In

values.description: The label value must not be in the supplied set of values.
values.name: NotIn

values.description: The label key must exist, regardless of its value.
values.name: Exists

values.description: The label key must not exist.
values.name: DoesNotExist
